api/bifrost/commands/__init__.py.name: Entity command routing
api/bifrost/commands/__init__.py.description: Sends each entity command, such as workflows or apps, to the right handler with the arguments someone typed.

api/bifrost/commands/admin.py.name: Platform admin commands
api/bifrost/commands/admin.py.description: Shows which runs and remote helpers are still using older sign-in credentials.

api/bifrost/commands/agents.py.name: Agent commands
api/bifrost/commands/agents.py.description: Creates, lists, edits and deletes agents from the terminal.

api/bifrost/commands/app.py.name: App project commands
api/bifrost/commands/app.py.description: Creates, links, runs locally and deploys an app project that lives in its own repository.

api/bifrost/commands/apps.py.name: App management commands
api/bifrost/commands/apps.py.description: Lists, creates, edits, publishes and deletes apps, and inspects or refreshes the shared app toolkit they use.

api/bifrost/commands/audit.py.name: Audit log commands
api/bifrost/commands/audit.py.description: Reads the audit trail and explains how a past access decision was reached.

api/bifrost/commands/base.py.name: Shared command plumbing
api/bifrost/commands/base.py.description: Gives every entity command the same output format, sign-in handling and error reporting.

api/bifrost/commands/claims.py.name: Custom claim commands
api/bifrost/commands/claims.py.description: Creates and manages custom claims that carry extra facts about a person into sign-in.

api/bifrost/commands/configs.py.name: Setting value commands
api/bifrost/commands/configs.py.description: Lists, sets, updates and removes stored settings by name or key.

api/bifrost/commands/events.py.name: Event source commands
api/bifrost/commands/events.py.description: Manages the outside events workflows react to, including their listeners, signing secrets and renewals.

api/bifrost/commands/files.py.name: Workspace file commands
api/bifrost/commands/files.py.description: Reads, writes, moves, searches and deletes workspace files, and manages who may reach them.

api/bifrost/commands/forms.py.name: Form commands
api/bifrost/commands/forms.py.description: Lists, creates, edits and retires forms from the terminal.

api/bifrost/commands/integrations.py.name: Integration commands
api/bifrost/commands/integrations.py.description: Manages connected outside services and which organization each connection serves.

api/bifrost/commands/orgs.py.name: Organization commands
api/bifrost/commands/orgs.py.description: Lists, creates, edits and removes organizations.

api/bifrost/commands/permissions.py.name: Permission catalogue
api/bifrost/commands/permissions.py.description: Shows every permission the platform checks and what each one allows.

api/bifrost/commands/policy_rules.py.name: Access rule commands
api/bifrost/commands/policy_rules.py.description: Manages reusable access rules and shows where each one is used.

api/bifrost/commands/requirements.py.name: Extra package commands
api/bifrost/commands/requirements.py.description: Adds or removes extra Python packages a workspace needs and restarts the runners that use them.

api/bifrost/commands/retention.py.name: Data retention commands
api/bifrost/commands/retention.py.description: Shows, previews and changes how long finished runs and audit records are kept.

api/bifrost/commands/roles.py.name: Role commands
api/bifrost/commands/roles.py.description: Lists, creates, edits and removes roles.

api/bifrost/commands/services.py.name: Service commands
api/bifrost/commands/services.py.description: Starts, stops, restarts and inspects always-on services, their history and their logs.

api/bifrost/commands/solution.py.name: Solution commands
api/bifrost/commands/solution.py.description: Creates, links, deploys, shares and updates Solutions, the packaged bundles of apps, workflows and forms.

api/bifrost/commands/tables.py.name: Table commands
api/bifrost/commands/tables.py.description: Creates and manages data tables and who may read or change their records.

api/bifrost/commands/users.py.name: Person access commands
api/bifrost/commands/users.py.description: Shows what a person is allowed to do and changes the roles they hold.

api/bifrost/commands/workflows.py.name: Workflow commands
api/bifrost/commands/workflows.py.description: Lists, registers, runs, edits and deletes workflows, and manages who may use them.
